preRegisteredFalsifiers: F1 (dispatch) -- Five-key provenance refuses an incomplete write and never defaults a key. Violation: remove each of the five keys in turn and confirm 400 + the missing key named, then confirm the write lands when all five are present.

F2 (dispatch) -- Revision, not sibling. Violation: upload the same docSlug twice and confirm ONE document at v2; upload a different docSlug with the same title and confirm a genuinely new document. Both paths, not one.

F3 (dispatch) -- No file-browser vocabulary where the design forbids it, checked as a file. Violation: plant a refused term and confirm the checker catches it; and confirm the substituted terms are PRESENT, because an absence-only check passes on an empty page.
F4 (dispatch) -- check.mjs passes with a NON-ZERO matched-input count, and fails against a planted violation in both directions.

F5 (added) -- The three not-indexed reasons are distinguished on real bytes, and a row with NO recorded reason reads reason-not-recorded rather than being inferred from content_type. Violation: upload a text PDF, a JSON record, a valid text-less PDF and a corrupt PDF; then null a row's reason and confirm the read refuses to guess.

F6 (added) -- Coverage travels with its denominator, over the same population as the results beside it. Violation: assert `coverage.inScope` equals the listing's own row count, not just a number the build chose.

F7 (added) -- A refusal names what it wanted, on the surface as well as the wire. Violation: submit an upload with an empty key in the real UI and confirm the refusal is rendered where the fix has to be made.
